Yin Jian’s interception and Sima Bao’s actual death retain the existing AD318 lower floor from the s0234 Yuan accession/retained Jianxing6 anchor, through the linked crisis and flight sequence. Bao’s invitation of Zhang Mao is in a distinct earlier-career backstory introduced at s0255–s0257; 建興初 retains the existing AD313 lower floor. The following 二年 court summons and later 太興三年 elevation remain separate anchors and are not borrowed as exact invitation or Bao death years. Mao refused the offered service, so Bao’s recruiting attestation is not evidence of accepted service by Mao. Original uncertain certainties and all Western bounds remain intact. claims.reason: s0241 makes Sima Bao’s planned flight to Zhang Shi the immediate problem; s0242 遣其將陰監逆保 explicitly names Yin Jian as the officer sent by Zhang Shi. 聲言翼衛，實禦之也 distinguishes the ostensible escort from actual exclusion. s0234 是歲…改年太興…建興六年 supplies the current AD318 accession anchor; subsequent 俄而/未幾/會 clauses continue Bao’s crisis to the interception. This is Yin Jian’s own current mission, not Bao’s act or a later retrospective citation. Retain onOrAfter AD318 from s0234’s 是歲 accession/太興 and local 建興六年 anchor, with the finer intervening crisis sequence. No exact interception/death year or new upper endpoint is asserted.

s0255–s0256 explicitly open the biography/backstory of Zhang Mao. s0257 建興初，南陽王保辟從事中郎 names Prince Sima Bao as the recruiter; Mao declined the positions, so the attestation belongs to Bao as the inviting prince, not evidence that Mao actually served. The opening Jianxing period has a conventional AD313 lower floor; it is distinct from the retained local 建興六年 label in s0234. s0258 二年 dates a subsequent summons, and s0260 太興三年 dates Mao’s later elevation after Shi’s death. Neither supplies an exact year for Bao’s earlier invitation. Retain onOrAfter AD313 with 建興初 as an opening-period expression, not exact 建興元年. Preserve following 二年 and 太興三年 as the separate subsequent events they directly date.

s0243 會保薨 explicitly gives Sima Bao’s actual death following the planned flight and Yin Jian interception in s0241–s0242, within the crisis narrated after s0234’s current accession heading. The death is Bao’s, not Zhang Shi’s assassination at s0250 or Zhang Mao’s later succession at s0260. Existing onOrAfter AD318 is supported by the narrative; s0260 太興三年 is a separate succession anchor and is not an explicit Bao death-year statement. No external death year should be imported or presented as an exact year in this claim. Retain onOrAfter AD318 from s0234’s 是歲 accession/太興 and local 建興六年 anchor, with the finer intervening crisis sequence. No exact interception/death year or new upper endpoint is asserted.
